text: or SIM isn't VoLTE-compatible | Whether the device is an imported/older model | Confirm device VoLTE support before assuming it's a settings issue | | VoLTE toggle present but calls still fall back to voice-only | Setting not actually enabled, or band incompatibility on an imported device | Whether VoLTE/4G Calling is switched on | Enable the setting; if already on, this may be a device band limitation | ### Example Scenario **Customer situation:** A customer has a 4G phone bought overseas and can't get VoLTE/HD Voice to work. **What happens:** Since some imported devices support 4G data without supporting VoLTE on Indian bands, this may be a device limitation rather than something fixable through account or SIM changes. ### Related Information Related documents referenced in NovaTel's internal metadata for this topic: KB_C12_overview.
